persistent_global_drawdown_regime.arming_rule: latch once doubled-cost-stressed closed balance reaches $550
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.trigger_state: candidate stressed sampled-equity drawdown from the immutable global account-equity high-watermark
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.entry_action: at the first binding global-DD trigger with nonzero open exposure, realize the released fraction of aggregate marked floating P/L, retain the declared current-book fraction and subtract $25
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.persistent_birth_control: while risk-off, every later original birth enters at the declared multiplier and pays another $0.10 modeling reserve
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.recovery: risk-on resumes only when candidate stressed sampled-equity DD is at or below 2% of the unchanged global high and every release/scaled lifecycle from the episode has naturally cleared
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.trigger_without_open_exposure: remain risk-on and wait for the first later sampled snapshot with open exposure while global drawdown remains binding
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.release_transition_equity_envelope: through the last released original close, apply min(-$25, episode release final candidate-minus-baseline delta); afterward settle the exact episode delta
persistent_global_drawdown_regime.scaled_birth_transition_equity_envelope: from scaled birth through original close, apply the minimum of -$0.10, its final candidate-minus-baseline delta, and forfeited positive observed peak mark; afterward settle the exact delta

snapshot_alignment.method: within each server timestamp, match candidate account balance to the nearest before/after lifecycle-close state and transfer cumulative doubled-cost drag to sampled equity

selection_drawdown_calibration.budgeted_formula: max(qualified native DD + 0.25, worse conservative sampled actual/stressed equity DD + 0.193561860 + 0.50)

selection_gates.profit: after every embedded $25 regime-entry reserve, each scaled-birth $0.10 reserve and a further $100 uncertainty reserve, actual and doubled-cost-stressed net must each strictly exceed qualified observed +$1,691.54 / +$1,626.26
selection_gates.epochs: all four modified actual and stressed epoch nets must be positive
selection_gates.capital: actual and stressed modified closed balances and sampled equity envelopes must remain positive
selection_gates.drawdown: budgeted native equity DD must be at or below 20%

selection_role.ordering: maximize conservative stressed selection net, then conservative actual net and recent-epoch stressed net, minimize budgeted DD, prefer the larger trigger, current-book retention and future-birth multiplier
